message.content: {"reachable":true,"rationale":"A valid attack sequence is phish_workstation → pivot_internal → auth_appserver → kerberoast_dc → auth_dc → escalate_dc → dump_dbadmin_dc → auth_db → escalate_db → exfiltrate_db. Phishing supplies foothold_workstation and stolen_user; segmentation and user/admin MFA are not deployed, so the internal pivot and subsequent authentication steps are enabled. Compromising the domain controller supplies admin_dc and stolen_dbadmin. Although mfa_dbadmin is deployed, auth_db explicitly permits authentication when admin_dc is true. The deployed proxy and ADFS patches do not block this sequence, which reaches exfiltrated=true."}
